notes.title: Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia will be updated to 2.1!
notes.notes: [p]◆To coincide with the sale, Assault Armored Girls Wars: Vasileia will be updated to version 2.1![/p][p][/p][p]- One new shot weapon has been added.[/p][p]- One new accessory has been added.[/p][p][/p][p]- The specifications for plasma damage have been changed. Even if the enemy is guarding, it will still deplete two-thirds of their boost gauge.[/p][p][/p][p]- Plasma damage from blade-type melee attacks has been increased.[/p][p]- As a result of the above changes, it is now possible to significantly deplete an enemy's boost gauge with blade-type melee attacks against a guarding enemy.[/p][p][/p][p]- Bug fixes have been made.[/p][p][/p][p]- The update is scheduled for September 28th.[/p][p]- We hope you continue to enjoy Assault Armored Girls Wars: Vasileia.[/p]

notes.title: "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" major update!!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566389/68cfefe05d66921f807dbc3de353922dae50969a.png"][/img][/p][p]■We are planning a major update for "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" to coincide with our summer sale![/p][p]The main changes are as follows.[/p][p][/p][p]◇A boss rush will be added as end content.[/p][p]◇New weapons and accessories will be added.[/p][p]◇User activity will be improved.[/p][p]*You can access the end content by loading a cleared save data.[/p][p][/p][p]A new area will be added as end content where you can fight "Sisters" and "Gatekeepers" consecutively.[/p][p]This will be a high-difficulty battle area where you cannot save midway.[/p][p]Your clear time will be recorded.[/p][p][/p][p]Two new types of melee attacks, two new heavy melee attacks, and one new ranged attack will be added.[/p][p]Several accessories will also be added.[/p][p][/p][p]We are very grateful for your feedback. We will make corrections that reflect your feedback and improve user activity. The following is an overview.[/p][p][/p][p]・Improved UI.[/p][p]・Warnings will now be displayed when boost is running low or when locked on.[/p][p]・Eliminated landing gaps.[/p][p]・Improved AI.[/p][p]・Changed the specifications of plasma damage.[/p][p]　Even if the opponent is guarding, it will still reduce half of their boost gauge.[/p][p]・Shooting attacks are now easier to hit even at close range.[/p][p]・The tutorial stage has been simplified.[/p][p]・Starting equipment has been changed.[/p][p]・Weapon balancing has been adjusted.[/p][p]・Bugs have been fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]The update is scheduled for June 25, 2025.[/p][p]We have added updates to make "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" easier to play.[/p][p]We hope that even if you were not satisfied with the initial version, you will play again.[/p][p]We hope that even if you have completed "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" you will enjoy the end content.[/p]

notes.title: Vasileia 1.1.13 has been updated.
notes.notes:
Fighting attacks have been enhanced.
During all fighting attacks, the back dash can be canceled by pressing the A button and the dodge roll can be canceled by pressing the X button.
Both the back dash and dodge roll are invincible.
The same action can be performed while guarding.
Boost gauge consumption for all dashes has been reduced.
Bugs have been fixed.
